description: Respondent sequence number (links to the analytic dataset)
Base PREVENT 10-year total CVD risk (identical to risk in the analytic dataset)
Base PREVENT 10-year total CVD risk with eGFR set to 90 mL/min per 1.73 m2 (kidney term removed)
PREVENT-ASCVD 10-year risk >= 5% (2026 dyslipidemia guideline statin threshold)
PREVENT total CVD 10-year risk >= 7.5% (2025 blood-pressure guideline threshold)
Grip strength at or below the sex-specific weighted 25th percentile of the primary cohort (39.9 kg men; 24.7 kg women)
Mobility, ADL, or IADL limitation (1 = any present; 0 = all three classifiable and absent; NA = otherwise); interpretable at age 60-79
